address: 19 route de la Fontaine, L'Abergement-Clémenciat, 01400, France
bio: On the high street of a Dombes village, this establishment has been in the family since 1899! Nowadays, father and son cook together, crafting an inventive carte blanche mystery menu of elaborate dishes based on good, fresh ingredients. Meals are served in the low-key, stylish dining room or on the summer patio....
